Damn it...
Damn it!

Bloodstained Shamshir. Ｉt belonged to

D-damn it, we're outmatched!

Looks like we've traded places since

FI FA...

You can't win. You've got no other

Damn it. All right, Ｉ'll hear what

Don't be ridiculous. Ｉ was asking

...How much?
A million gold will settle it.

But...

Nothing left for us here. See you

Ｉ wanted to be a great pirate like my

Ｉ'd have proof Ｉ was getting closer

Ｉ realized Ｉ didn't really want to be

No wonder they turned on me. Ｉ was

Ｉt was my father Ｉ was trying to

Ｉ'm pulling back for today! Next

Tch. Ｉ'll pull back for now, but Ｉ'll

Ｉ'm Aziza Nurennahar!
She doesn't give up easily, does she?

Ｉ did underestimate you. That won't

Ｉt's no use! We're no match for her.

Espinosa?

Hm? What a rude girl.
There's no point denying it.

Listen carefully. Ｉ haven't the time

Ｉ'll never stand for that.

Do you want to make me angry? Ｉt

Ｉ'm not afraid of your threats.

Ｉ've had enough of this. Let's go!

FI! You were the one who told me

Ｉ couldn't let that go.

Ｉ see. Then we can take the fight to

Juan...

FI!
Ryoke...!

FI! What do we do?
Aid Gerhard's fleet
Withdraw

Aye!
A-aah!

Ｉ've heard how well you're doing.

Ｉ'd a hundred times rather fight and

Ｉmpudent brat. You'll be singing a
